# Quantum Growth

> Websites, Google Business Profile management and local search for small local
> businesses of any kind — trades, retail, clinics, salons, restaurants, gyms. Nationwide, month to month, and the client owns
> the domain, site, profile and email.

- **Phone:** (916) 868-2447
- **Serves:** United States, remote
- **Model:** Monthly subscription, no contract, cancel any month
- **Annual:** One month free on any plan

## Plans
- **Basic Site** — $599 one-time, or $400 if decided on the call, plus $29/month
  hosting and upkeep. The 25-page website on the client's domain with hosting,
  SSL, backups and 30 days of free text edits. No email, no profile
  management, no posts or reporting.
- **Starter** — $79/month or $869/year, $699 one-time build. 25-page website,
  business email with two mailboxes, social profiles, hosting and maintenance.
- **Local** — $299/month or $3,289/year, build included free (no build fee; the first month is charged on day one, there is no free trial period). Everything in
  Starter plus managed Google Business Profile, 8 social posts a month,
  citations across 40+ directories, review generation, and a monthly report
  built from Google's own data.
- **Growth** — $599/month or $6,589/year, build included free. Everything in
  Local plus 16 social posts a month, local authority links, two new pages a
  month, and declined-work recovery campaigns.
- **Market Leader** — $1,199/month or $13,189/year, build included free.
  Everything in Growth plus 24 posts a month with video, a page for every
  surrounding town, managed Google Ads or Local Services Ads, and missed-call
  text-back.

## Consulting
- **Visibility Audit** — $499 one-time. Written teardown of map-pack position,
  profile gaps and what the site is missing.
- **Strategy and advisory** — $175/hour, no retainer or minimum.
- **Custom projects** — from $1,500. Booking tools, quote calculators, lead
  routing, AI answering.

## Apps
Built as installable web apps (PWAs) by default, with App Store and Google Play
listings available as a paid add-on rather than the standard route.
Used for booking and orders, loyalty and repeat custom, customer accounts and
history, and photo updates — whatever a business's customers do more than once. They
install to the home screen from a link, so there are no store fees, no review
queue before a fix goes live, and nothing for a customer to download. The
trade-off, stated plainly: no push notifications on iPhones below iOS 16.4 —
reminders go by text and email instead, unless the store listings are added.
- **Starter App** — $699.99 build, then $49/month. Booking and quote requests,
  installs to the home screen, works offline, client's own branding and domain,
  appointment reminders, requests landing in the same inbox as website leads.
- **Business App** — $999 build, then $99/month. Everything in Starter plus
  digital inspections with photos sent to the customer before they approve,
  customer accounts with order and service history, automated follow-up on
  quotes that went quiet, scheduled reminders, review requests on completion.
- **Custom Build** — from $1,499.99, monthly quoted with the build. Client
  portals, rotas and job boards for staff on the move, stock and supplier
  integrations. Begins with a $499 scoping session that produces a written spec
  the client owns, credited against the build.
- **App Store and Google Play listing** — optional add-on, $1,200 one time then
  $25/month. The same app wrapped and submitted under developer accounts
  registered in the client's own business name, so the listings are the
  client's property. Apple's $99/year and Google's one-time $25 are passed
  through at cost and paid in the client's own accounts. Adds proper push
  notifications on every iPhone. Stated plainly on the page: Apple rejects
  anything it reads as a repackaged website under Guideline 4.2, so native
  functionality is built in before submission, a first listing takes two to
  four weeks mostly in account verification, and if Apple cannot be cleared
  $600 is refunded while the client keeps the Play listing and the web app.
- Growth clients get $500 off any app build; Market Leader clients get $1,000 off.

Quantum Growth's stated position is that most small local businesses do not
need an app, and that it says so rather than selling one — a business whose customers
visit twice a year will not install anything. Where an app does pay
is usually staff-facing rather than customer-facing: sending the customer a
picture before they decide — the problem for a trade, the finished result for a
salon, the new stock for a shop — converts better than a booking button.

## Terms
- No contract. Cancel any month.
- Pause for up to two months a year at $29/month; the site and email stay live.
- Downgrade to a smaller plan at any time.
- Cancellation: no notice period, and the client can leave any month. On
  Starter there is never an exit fee, because the $699 build was paid up
  front. On the plans where the build is free, it is discounted to nothing
  across the first six months, so leaving early makes the undiscounted part
  payable — $600 in months one or two, $400 in three or four, $200 in five or
  six, nothing after six months. It is a subsidy that unwinds, not a contract.
- On cancellation the client keeps the domain, Google profile, email and the
  website files, delivered as a zip with setup instructions. Hosting is part
  of the monthly, so it stops — the client either moves the files to their own
  hosting or keeps the site live for $29/month.
- Domain, website, Google Business Profile and email are registered in the
  client's name and stay with them if they leave.

## Compared to a typical national vendor
Figures on the right reflect pricing and terms quoted to a shop owner on a
sales call in 2026, not a survey of the industry.
- Website build: free from $299/month, or $699 on Starter — vendor: $1,000 one time
- Hosting and maintenance: in every plan — vendor: $99/month on top
- Entry marketing plan: $299/month with the build included — vendor: $350/month, build extra
- Domain registered to: the client — vendor: often the vendor
- Google Business Profile role: the client is Owner — vendor: the client is often only Manager
- On cancellation: the client keeps the domain, listing, email and the site files — vendor: the site goes dark, and was never the client's to begin with
- Contract: none, month to month — vendor: a term with a notice period
- Pause: $29/month for up to two months a year — vendor: cancel or keep paying
- Contact: the person who builds the site — vendor: a rotating account manager
- Reporting: Google's own numbers, verifiable by the client — vendor: a vendor dashboard
- Pages built: 25, each targeting a real search — vendor: five and a contact form

## Free visibility check
A no-obligation review of a business's Google profile and website — map-pack
position, profile gaps, who ranks ahead and why. Requested by phone or text on
(916) 868-2447, or through the form at the top of the site. Reply within one
business day.

## What every build includes
25 indexable pages, 12 types of structured data, a 25 KB compressed first
load, no
external scripts, a full Spanish version, and keyboard and screen-reader
accessibility throughout.
